questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school or school crossing. Stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what traffic laws to follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a left turn where this sign is posted. It is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right side of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions just ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment display this emblem. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You will see this sign displayed on vehicles that travel slowly on roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones and let construction vehicles or workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers about upcoming curves in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers of an upcoming intersection so they can prepare for other traffic or prepare to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. These signs show where children and pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells drivers that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming curves and sharp turns ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that lanes are being reduced and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign tells you a side road is intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic from the right lane is merging. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass. Then you may proceed if it is safe.
